title: Remote work in practice
intro: Your office needs protection at home too. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: New VPN app version

artifact.subject: New VPN app version
body: The update will install on your work computer automatically. Do not download anything.

decisions.explain: The domain is correct and you are not asked to download anything.

decisions.title: Home router sign-in
decisions.prompt: You open your home router's settings for the first time. Safe, or a risk?

artifact.title: HomeRouter
body: HomeRouter settings. The factory sign-in is filled in.

decisions.explain: Factory passwords are public knowledge. Change the router password now.

decisions.title: Message from Tural, colleague

artifact.name: Tural, colleague
body: I can't get into the system from home. Tell me your password, just for a minute.

decisions.explain: A password is never shared, not even with a colleague. Suggest he contacts tech support.

decisions.title: Free VPN download
decisions.prompt: You need to reach work systems from a café. Safe, or a risk?

artifact.title: Super Free VPN
body: Unlimited, fast and 100% free. No sign-up.

decisions.explain: An unknown free VPN can read your traffic. Use only the organisation's VPN for work.
